# Relish on 66

> Modern Indian restaurant in Edmonton offering delicious food, live tandoor, and premium dining experiences.

Relish on 66 is a contemporary Indian restaurant located in Edmonton, Alberta, specializing in authentic Indian cuisine with a modern twist. The restaurant offers a premium dining experience, featuring live tandoor cooking and a diverse menu that caters to families, friends, and special events. It is situated on Ellerslie Road, making it a convenient and accessible choice for locals and visitors seeking high-quality Indian food in a sophisticated setting.
